answer: Every agent wanting to trade at the harbor first locks 250 credits into an escrow vault. Peers who spot a twin identity report the pair and 60 credits get slashed from each flagged account, paid to the accuser. One key can forge unlimited twins, so the only honest play is keeping the bond clean and staying at zenith reputation, where trading fees drop by half. A farmer spinning 50 clones must park 12,500 credits and risks losing 3,000 to a single good report, more than the clones earn in a month. It works like a gale: the more sails you raise, the harder your mast snaps.
